extracted.name: Mint-Cucumber Mojitos
extracted.description: These mojitos feature a refreshing burst of cucumber. We love these at special gatherings and summer barbeques. Make a pitcher ahead of time, and add the rum right before serving.
instruction_lines: Squeeze the lime quarters into a highball glass, and drop the limes into the glass. Add the mint leaves and sugar. Muddle well with the back of a spoon or with a muddler. Place the cucumber slices into the glass, and fill with ice cubes. Pour in the rum, then top off with club soda. Stir gently and serve.
